subject: SITE_OWNER_ASSIGNMENT: Creative Studio public share preview and CFA separation note
body:
SITE_OWNER_ASSIGNMENT: Make the Creative Studio/story-production app the accurate public-facing identity now. Site Nova retains sole implementation/build/publication ownership. Update only the necessary README preview lead, page title and durable separation note; preserve historical CFA material and behavior. Use established creative branding covering Hon, Lisan and Project Baldadoon. Do not invent features or create a repository migration, unrelated redesign, broad code rebrand, purchases or generations. Keep Claude paused.

Ziggy's October 30 decision explicitly accepts prioritizing creative branding despite the shared repository. Preserve the original Contextual Framework Analysis tool identity and future separation need in a durable note. His statement: "Okay - yes Leave whatever note we have to to make that separation but for now since we’re not even really flying the tool site anymore the real you know boots on the ground contextual framework analysis system I want ours forward facing. I don’t want the link we’re given out here to be inaccurate."

Fresh baseline at 2026-10-30 21:24:24-26 UTC: facebookexternalhit/1.1 gets HTTP 200, title/og:title Creative Studio | CFA, og:description "The  is the first interactive epistemic laboratory built to measure how frameworks hold their gro...", same app-wide Home_Page.png, and Cache-Control no-store for root and Hon Storyboard URLs. Routing works; no claim of unique query-string previews. Official Streamlit preview documentation says title is page_title, description is repository README, and daily screenshot may lag 24 hours: https://docs.streamlit.io/deploy/streamlit-community-cloud/share-your-app/share-previews

Please acknowledge this file and return exact changed files/copy, verification, remote commit and live crawler title/description through a reply/receipt. Distinguish local change, publication, host metadata refresh and client caches. If wording needs a real creative choice, return it to Nova Dot. Native task notification was successfully sent to 01a13383-26f6-7923-8e18-98faf1fa3ede; send acceptance does not yet establish owner acknowledgment.
